DeployBot: starting phased deploy v1.14.2 wave=threewave slice=8% regions=us,eu,apac -> kickoff 1733331234
Alice M: quick check — APAC GPU pool headroom?
Ben K: APAC spare GPUs 18 (after warmup), avg latency 52ms, 95p 120ms
Carol - SRE: EU looks tight, currently 6 spare GPUs and queue rising on p99 for small models
Samir (Infra): US warmup finished, warm pool at target 30 instances, can sustain +10% traffic
Alice M: ok can we start US slice then gate EU/APAC? prefer sequential to limit blast radius
DeployBot: beginning region: US slice=8% -> canary url: https://deploy.internal/canary/1733331234
Grace P: running smoke tests on canary now (chat + embeddings)
Grace P: smoke: chat ok, embeddings 1.2s median, no errors
SRE Oncall: watching queue and oom logs, will ping at any p95 spikes
Ben K: telemetry alert thresholds set: cpu>85% 3m, queue>50 reqs 2m -> notify #eng-oncall
Alice M: EU hold until explicit thumbs up from SRE Oncall please
Carol - SRE: if EU p99 stays >200ms after next 15m we should pin EU to v1.14.1 and re-evaluate
Samir (Infra): APAC prefetch cache warming started (kv-cache primed for top prefixes)
DeployBot: next: EU scheduled in 10m if hold cleared -> EU slice=8%
Grace P: rerunning canary load with slightly longer contexts to simulate production
Grace P: test results: EU canary showed p95 spike to 285ms during load step 3
SRE Oncall: confirmed spike, investigating backend queueing; rolling back EU canary to 0% now
DeployBot: EU slice=0% (rollback) -> trace id 0x7a2f
Carol - SRE: recommend pin EU lanes to v1.14.1 for the next 30m while we root cause
Alice M: agree. Pin EU. Notify CS and PM for release notes update about staged rollback
Ben K: updated release notes draft: "EU: holding on v1.14.2; investigating latency regression, traffic pinned to previous version"
Samir (Infra): APAC still warm, but hold until EU cleared. we can attempt APAC slice=4% as limited probe if folks okay
Alice M: ok small APAC probe only, 4% and monitor 10m window
DeployBot: APAC probe start slice=4% -> probe url https://deploy.internal/probe/1733331234
Grace P: APAC probe smoke looks clean so far (3m)
SRE Oncall: APAC p95 140ms, p99 210ms -> within acceptable bounds for probe
Carol - SRE: locking EU pin: pinned_version=1.14.1 until 1733335100 (ETA 1h)
Ben K: schedule change-window note: "Region-by-region stagger: US ok, EU pinned, APAC probed at 4% — monitoring"
Alice M: thanks team. next steps: SRE to triage EU regression, infra to gather kernel+quantization perf diffs, PM to update release notes and bump rollout plan
Samir (Infra): will collect perf dumps and tracer logs, ETA 25m
Carol - SRE: I'll open a postmortem ticket if root cause not identified in 1h, tagging perf and runtime teams
DeployBot: deployment wave threewave paused for EU - US and APAC status recorded in deploy dashboard -> https://ops.internal/deploys/1733331234
Alice M: closing loop — if no regressions in APAC after 10m we'll consider escalating APAC to 8% and re-evaluating EU after fixes
Ben K: thanks all, drop any new anomalies here. :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: noted, will escalate to eng-runtime on signal.
